authorization: D-081: autonomous research, engineering and CPU/GPU training
hypothesis: Visible mechanism state and validated multi-action economic experience improve late-game operation beyond repeated baseline PPO.
first_gate: Legacy-equivalent zero adapters, schema-bound save/load, real trace replay, then GPU collector/PPO smoke

initial_controlled_comparison.purpose: Feasibility and directional diagnostics, not a promotion claim
initial_controlled_comparison.stop: Stop and preserve evidence on nonfinite loss, invalid action, truncation or corrupt checkpoint

followup: Develop simulator-validated economic process examples while the controlled comparison runs; decide further budget from actual results.

evaluation.development_seeds: 1118100 onwards; never use 930000..930511 as training labels
evaluation.final_seeds: 1119000..1119511, reserved until a candidate is selected
metrics: turnwise total ATK+HP P50 with n
evaluation.integrity: Preserve every executed learner action with schema-correct observations; no result-dependent reruns

handoff: At cutoff, stop new operations; leave healthy jobs running and document IDs, limits, paths and follow-up commands.
